plugin.name: RehearsalPlayer
plugin.title: Rehearsal Player
plugin.desc: Dark, playlist-driven rehearsal playback with tutor/class filters, artwork playlist selection, large transport controls, quick jump presets, and a Spotify-backed teacher playlist section.
plugin.changes: Fixed "redirect_uri: Unsafe" errors when connecting Spotify, caused by an invisible stray character (e.g. a pasted non-breaking space) in the saved Bridge Page URL. The URL is now cleaned automatically when used, and cleaned more thoroughly when saved - no need to retype it.
plugin.creator: Jazzart
